justification: Inspected the 12 exact-package classes under `javase/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/client/j2se/` (`CommandLineRunner.java`, `CommandLineEncoder.java`, `GUIRunner.java`, `DecodeWorker.java`, `DecoderConfig.java`, `EncoderConfig.java`, `ImageReader.java`, `MatrixToImageWriter.java`, `MatrixToImageConfig.java`, `BufferedImageLuminanceSource.java`, `HtmlAssetTranslator.java`, `StringsResourceTranslator.java`). The package totals 1,774 LOC, and the largest class is only 273 lines (`DecodeWorker.java`); the rest are small helpers/configs. Responsibilities are spread across distinct, narrow utilities (CLI decode/encode runners, GUI runner, image IO, matrix rendering, and two deprecated translation tools) rather than concentrated in one oversized or monolithic package.
